# Nobody Is Above the Law

<!-- STEP id="same-rules-for-all" -->
## The Captain and the Umpire

In cricket, a captain cannot overrule the umpire by shouting louder, because both follow the rules of the game. In the same way, the **Rule of Law** means that no one is above the law: a minister and a student follow the same law.

<!-- STEP id="court-not-force" -->
## Disputes Go to Court

When laws are violated, disputes are resolved in a court of law, not by force or personal influence. No citizen can be punished without following the procedure established by law, and everyone gets a fair chance to defend their rights.

<!-- STEP id="what-about-the-powerful" -->
## What About Powerful People?

A powerful person might ask an official to drop a case, perhaps in one phone call. Under the Rule of Law, that call must change nothing, because the case follows the same procedure.

**The Rule of Law prevents misuse of power and protects people's rights.**
